FT-043.adaptation: Reused flashtex_project_files::ProjectRoot (openat/O_NOFOLLOW rooted reader) in place of rev1's canonicalize-based rooting after verifying it preserves (and exceeds) rev1's traversal/absolute-path/symlink-escape rejection; kept two deliberate behavior changes (dot/empty-segment normalization instead of hard rejection, every symlink refused instead of only escaping ones) as tightenings, not gaps, and updated tests accordingly. Added preview_import (no-write, full-hash New/Unchanged/Conflict classification) and apply_import (typed OverwriteNotDecided on an undecided conflict, ConcurrentModification on a race, no force anywhere), plus build_bundle_with_limits for entry-count/total-byte bounds.
